With Om, Brahma created this cosmos, and from Om constituted of the three isolated letters A, U, M, the vyāhṛitis came forth: bhūh, bhuvah, svah.

From these three vyāhṛitis, the three pādas of the Gāyatri-Mantra emanated. From the three pādsas of the Gāyatri-Mantra, the meaning of the three sections of the Puruṣha-Sūkta emerged, and from the meaning of the Puruṣha-Sūkta, the meaning of the entire Vedas emanated, and from this vast meaning of the Vedas, Brahma created this cosmos, say the scriptures.

It is constituted of A, U, M, representing all creation; but it has also a fourth nature which transcends these distinctions of A, U, M.
